Zero-Arithmetic-Trust Barrier: LLM proposals are rejected if Gross - Fee - GST != Net Deposit
• Zero IEEE-754 Float Drift: All currency figures computed in exact integer minor units (paise).
• Bounded AI Authority: AI models reason on ambiguity, but cannot modify DB without Verifier Gate.
• Dual-Control Governance: Maker (Analyst) cannot approve their own proposed journal vouchers.
• Algorithmic Rigor: SciPy Hungarian bipartite matching eliminates greedy false reconciliations.
